ai.selection: For each exact paper generator cell, sort eligible decoded clean parent members by SHA-256(generator + member path) and take the first 40. No score, embedding, prompt content or image appearance may affect selection.

boundaries: No E39 FINAL image byte existed locally when this contract was recorded.
Acquisition and audit must run without loading or scoring the E39 model.
Published archive/catalog identities must match before transfer; any mismatch fails closed.
Every selected parent must decode and receive a local SHA-256 before the unscored manifest is frozen.
Exact and perceptual overlap with every earlier role is forbidden; derived copies never increase N.
The first frozen 440-parent manifest is the only E39 FINAL and may be scored exactly once.

real.selection: Only camera-native Nat/jpeg-h264 JPEG parents. Within each device sort by capture index, subject index, location index and URL, then take the first 40; this spreads selection across locations before repeating captures.

rejections.CID2013: licensed consumer photos, but database presentation images are scaled to 1600x1200 and only about six images/device
rejections.ForensiCam-215K: modern and diverse, but no sufficiently explicit downloadable dataset licence was found
rejections.SCIMD-6/17: all released images are resized to 224x224 and therefore are not native camera output
rejections.VISION/FODB/CSAFE/IPN: already consumed by earlier PixelProof roles or source collections and therefore not independent FINAL evidence
